Bambelo connects consumers with service providers through more than 40 comparison sites in the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain, France and Italy. When someone is looking for a painter, estate agent or gardener, we match them with an affiliated company. That company carries out the job itself.

There are around 60 of us in the centre of Breda. We are sales- and data-driven and always on the move. What works today can work better tomorrow.
